SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER


SELECT A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, SUM(A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) AS 'YTD ADB', C.ORGKEY
    FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES A
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON D.ACID = A.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE 
        A.isActive = 1
        AND A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = '' ---set date
        AND B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
        AND B.isLatest = 1 
        AND B.isActive = 1
        AND C.ORGKEY = '' ---set FCBS CIF
        AND D.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' ---exclude dummy accounts
    GROUP BY A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, C.ORGKEY
    ORDER BY A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE


SELECT SUM(A.TRAN_DATE_BAL) AS 'Deposit Out Bal', C.ORGKEY
    FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE A
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON D.ACID = A.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE 
        A.isActive = 1
        AND A.EOD_DATE >= '' AND A.END_EOD_DATE <= '' ---set date
        AND B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
        AND B.isLatest = 1 
        AND B.isActive = 1
        AND C.ORGKEY = '' ---set FCBS CIF
        AND D.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' ---exclude dummy accounts
    GROUP BY A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, C.ORGKEY
    ORDER BY A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE


SELECT A.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS 'Deposit Out Bal', C.ORGKEY
    FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE A
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON D.ACID = A.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE 
        A.isActive = 1
        AND A.EOD_DATE >= '' AND A.END_EOD_DATE <= '' ---set date
        AND B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
        AND B.isLatest = 1 
        AND B.isActive = 1
        AND C.ORGKEY = '' ---set FCBS CIF
        AND D.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' ---exclude dummy accounts
    ORDER BY D.FORACID


SELECT D.CustomerId, SUM(BalanceAmount) AS 'Deposit Out Bal'
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A
        LEFT JOIN bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipation B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory C ON C.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND C.SerialNumber = B.SerialNumber AND C.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN bnkm.Customer D ON D.CoreCustomerId = B.CoreCustomerId AND D.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
        LEFT JOIN bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct E ON E.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND E.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
    WHERE 
        A.PeriodStartDate >= '' AND A.PeriodEndDate <= ''
        AND C.RecordTypeId IN ('M', 'J')
        AND E.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
    GROUP BY D.CustomerId
